links.outcome: Differences between chatbots in source transparency and communication of uncertainty in Arabic migraine answers
links.effect: Accuracy did not differ across models (p = 0.072), but mDISCERN differed significantly (p < 0.001); clearest differences were in source transparency and communication of uncertainty.
links.quote: The clearest between-model differences were observed in source transparency and communication of uncertainty.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of Arabic-language LLM responses to patient FAQs about migraine evaluated by neurologists; does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
